Klasse SemVer

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.misc.SemVer
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Serializable, Comparable<SemVer>, Echo
public class SemVer extends Object implements Serializable, Comparable<SemVer>, Echo

Immutable representation of a Semantic Version (SemVer) according to the SemVer 2.0.0 specification.

A semantic version consists of three required numeric components (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) and two optional string components (pre-release and build metadata).

Semantics:

  • MAJOR: incremented for incompatible API changes
  • MINOR: incremented for backwards-compatible new functionality
  • PATCH: incremented for backwards-compatible bug fixes
  • Pre-Release: optional identifier for pre-release versions (e.g., "alpha", "beta.1")
  • Build Metadata: optional build information (e.g., "build.123", "20130313144700")

Precedence Rules:

  • Versions are compared by MAJOR, MINOR, and PATCH numerically
  • Pre-release versions have LOWER precedence than normal versions (1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0)
  • Build metadata is IGNORED during precedence comparison

Contract: all numeric components must be non-negative. String components must not be null when provided. The class is immutable; all modification methods return new instances.

Examples: 

  var v1 = SemVer.semVer(1, 2, 3);                    // "1.2.3"
  var v2 = v1.incrementMinor();                        // "1.3.0"
  var v3 = v1.withPreRelease("beta");                  // "1.2.3-beta"
  var v4 = v3.withBuildMetadata("build.456");          // "1.2.3-beta+build.456"

  v1.compareTo(v3);  // 1 (release > pre-release)

  var v5 = SemVer.semVerBuilder()
      .major(2)
      .minor(0)
      .patch(0)
      .preRelease("rc.1")
      .build();                                         // "2.0.0-rc.1"
Seit:
1.0.0

  • Methodendetails

    • parseSemVer

      public static SemVer parseSemVer(@NonNull String version)

      Parses a semantic version string into a SemVer instance.

      The parser accepts standard SemVer 2.0.0 format: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-PRERELEASE][+BUILDMETADATA]

      Examples of valid inputs:

      • "1.0.0"
      • "1.2.3-alpha"
      • "2.0.0-beta.1"
      • "1.0.0+build.123"
      • "1.2.3-rc.1+build.456"
      Parameter:
      version - the version string to parse; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a new SemVer instance; never null
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if version is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the version string is not valid SemVer format
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • incrementMajor

      public SemVer incrementMajor()

      Increments the major version.

      Following the SemVer specification, this resets the minor and patch versions to 0. The optional components are preserved.

      Gibt zurück:
      a new SemVer instance with incremented major version
      Seit:

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(@NonNull SemVer other)

      Compares this version to another SemVer based on precedence rules.

      Precedence is determined by the first difference when comparing MAJOR, MINOR, and PATCH components from left to right. Normal versions have higher precedence than pre-release versions. Build metadata is ignored.

      Angegeben von:
      compareTo in Schnittstelle Comparable<SemVer>
      Parameter:
      other - the version to compare to; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this version is less than, equal to, or greater than the specified version
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if other is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object o)

      Two SemVer instances are equal if and only if all their components (major, minor, patch, pre-release, and build metadata) are equal.

      Note: This differs from compareTo(SemVer), which ignores build metadata according to the SemVer 2.0.0 specification.

      Setzt außer Kraft:
      equals in Klasse Object
      Parameter:
      o - the object to compare with
      Gibt zurück:
      true if this version equals the specified object
      Seit:
      1.0.0
